description: Four VCAs with adjustable response curves and chained outputs, so leaving an output unpatched sends that channel on to the one below

params.text: Sets the level of that channel; with nothing patched into its CV input this knob alone sets the gain
Sets the response of that channel's CV, exponential counter-clockwise and linear clockwise

inputs.text: The audio or CV for that channel
Controls the gain of that channel, 5V giving unity on the linear curve and negative voltages closing it; while it is patched the gain knob scales what it does

outputs.text: That channel, summed with any channel above it whose own output is unpatched

notes: the module is monophonic: on a polyphonic cable only the first channel is read.
